description: This file implements multipart protocol parsing, including boundary detection, header parsing, and part extraction, built on top of a message parser. It defines classes for parsing multipart content, including ParameterParser and MultipartParser, with functions for handling multipart boundaries, headers, and body parts.

classes.name: ParameterParser
classes.description: Parses key-value parameters from a line, typically used for content-disposition headers in multipart data.

classes.name: MultipartParser
classes.description: Handles parsing of multipart content, including boundary detection, body segmentation, and header extraction for each part.

methods.name: ParameterParser::ParameterParser
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the parser with a line of text.

methods.name: ParameterParser::getKeyValue
methods.description: Returns the next key-value pair from the line, with support for quoted strings and delimiters.

methods.name: MultipartParser::MultipartParser
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the parser with a content type, extracting the boundary.

methods.name: MultipartParser::isValid
methods.description: Checks if the multipart parser has a valid boundary.

methods.name: MultipartParser::setBody
methods.description: Sets the body content to be parsed.

methods.name: MultipartParser::getNextPart
methods.description: Extracts the next part from the multipart body, returning headers and part data.
